text:
Sofia Alvarez: Hey team — quick pass needed on Nimbus partner asset set (logos, one-pager, 2 social tiles). Need marketing + legal signoff by EOD Thu. Uploads here: https://drive.redwood/partner-assets/nimbus
Mike Chen: Thanks. Quick Q — do we have a vector (SVG) for the Nimbus stacked lockup? The PNG they sent is low res for the one-pager.
Ravi Patel: I exported SVGs from their brand kit and cleaned up the paths. Files added: nimbus_logo_stack.svg, nimbus_wordmark.svg. They specify 24px clearspace on their guide.
Julia Park: Product asked to avoid overlapping their watermark on our hero image. Prefer a side-by-side lockup instead of overlay.
Marketing Bot: Reminder: use brand checklist v2 for co-brand assets. Social tiles need 72dpi and alt CTAs for EU versions. Guide: https://redwood.internal/brand-standards
Priya (Legal): Looping in legal review. Need written permission for using their customer quote in the one-pager and explicit logo usage permission. @Sofia — do we have a clause in the MSA about logos?
Sofia Alvarez: We have an NDA and an email thread but not an explicit logo usage clause. I pinged Nimbus PM — they said they'd confirm permissive use by tomorrow morning. In the meantime, can we produce a non-quote draft for design?
Mike Chen: I reflowed the one-pager copy to make room for co-brand lockups. Small ask: move our CTA below the fold on mobile view. I'll add export specs to Drive under exports/mobile/
Ravi Patel: Swapped hero background to neutral to avoid contrast/compliance issues. Added two PNG variants (web @72dpi, print @300dpi). I'll also add transparent PNGs for marketplace tiles.
Julia Park: Created two social copy variants: short (for marketplaces) and extended (for our channels). I'll assemble size variants for AWS Marketplace + Azure Marketplace tomorrow.
Marketing Bot: :thumbsup: Final assets for review uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood/partner-assets/nimbus/final — folder contains PDFs, SVGs, and tile exports.
Priya (Legal): Two quick legal notes: 1) Avoid language implying a deeper technical partnership level (e.g., 'official integration' needs partner-level agreement). Use "joint solution" or "collaboration" instead. 2) Any customer logos or quotes require explicit opt-in from the customer.
Sofia Alvarez: Good catches. Plan: remove any language claiming partner tier, swap hero to the neutral option, and publish a non-quote one-pager draft. Can folks review the Drive items by 3pm PT today? :calendar:
Mike Chen: I'll validate image crops and finalize SVGs by 2pm PT.
Ravi Patel: I'll export a ZIP of all final assets to exports/final/ and ping when done.
Julia Park: I'll prep the marketplace tile sizes and upload them to the marketplace-ready folder. ETA lunchtime tomorrow.
Sofia Alvarez: Thanks everyone — tagging this thread for asset-qa tracking. Will close when legal confirms logo use. :white_check_mark:
